title: Fix Panel Toggle Chip Jump Over Fullscreen
description: When toggling chrome-hosted panels (e.g. top-right inspector), the toggle chip should stay aligned with its folded navbar position and not jump over the fullscreen control while the panel body grows from the corner.
summary: PanelChromeTabBar keeps a width-matched aria-hidden placeholder while the panel is open so trailing fullscreen does not reflow. Open chrome-hosted right-anchored panels apply shellNavbarTrailingEndReserveCss padding-inline-start on the WindowChrome cap row so chips sit left of the fullscreen slot under RTL flow. Added WindowChrome capRowStyle and vitest coverage.
